label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly into redirect URL path at line 24 ('https://' + host + '/' + seg). While host is validated via regex to *.safe.com, the path segment 'seg' has no sanitization and can control navigation within the allowed domain, enabling potential open redirect or path traversal attacks. Resolved sink value includes attacker-controlled 'seg' parameter.

evidence.note: User input 'seg' from request.getParameter('seg') flows to redirect URL path without sanitization
